## Live replacement

**Live file swap: none.** No live hot swap into RAM; every change reboots the disc image (~5 min, unskippable opening movie).

**Pick whip: partial.** bot_at(x,y): heap scan 0x80600000-0x81000000 for the CFWorldMesh vtable, projected with the game camera (~40-50 s over the GDB stub) -> that bot type built as a new disc.

**Live controls:** metal_arms.identify (who the player is) and bots_on_screen over session RPC read_memory; no write controls.
